name: @vssaros/dsh-skills
description: VsSaros skills module for DeepSeek Harness: registers VsSaros skill directories (~/.vssaros/skills/<id>/SKILL.md) as a dsh skill provider, exposes BM25 skill_search + gated skill_manage tools (native `skill` tool still does loading), plus a self-hosted read-only catalog page. 0.7.1 adds OBSERVABILITY for autoload: every injection appends a line to <dataRoot>/skill-autoload.log (session, skill names, bytes) - without it the question of whether autoload fired is unanswerable in production (dsh session bodies are not persisted, and plugin ctx.logger never reaches main.log; measured 2026-10-19). 0.7.0 adds skill AUTOLOAD: config.skillAutoload lists skill names whose FULL body is injected as a user message on the first turn (equivalent to activation:always, which dsh lacks) - idempotent by <skill_content name=...> presence; off when the list is empty. Also fixes the CJK tokenizer: consecutive Chinese used to become ONE token, making Chinese queries never match descriptions (measured: recall@3 2/12 -> 9/12, paraphrase class 0/6 -> 6/6). 0.7.6 fixes the ROOT CAUSE of autoload never firing: `agent/pre-step` is an AGENT-SCOPED event (dsh declares it as `this: Scoped<Agent>`), so a listener registered on the plugin's root ctx never receives it - `apply()` runs fine (hence 50 `boot` lines) but the event simply never reaches that scope (hence zero `enter`). Found by comparing with dsh's built-in `time-context` plugin, which declares `export const inject = ['agents']`. This plugin cannot declare that at top level (it would make the WHOLE plugin depend on the agents service and stop activating in profiles without one, while its other jobs - skill directory provider, tools - must keep working), so the listener is now wrapped in `ctx.inject(['agents'], scope => scope.effect(() => scope.on(...)))`, which mounts it only when the service exists. Smoke updated with a synchronous `inject` fake. 0.7.7 fixes the error that 0.7.6 immediately exposed: cannot get property skills without inject. installSkillAutoload was invoked bare from apply() (not inside ctx.inject for the skills service), yet its body read ctx.skills - cordis throws for any undeclared service, so this always would have failed; it never showed up only because the handler had never once been reached (wrong scope). Now the call site is wrapped in ctx.inject(['skills'], scope => installSkillAutoload(ctx, config, { skills: scope.skills })) and the body reads deps.skills (with a try/catch fallback to ctx.skills purely for the offline smoke, since on a real host that read throws rather than returning undefined). Net effect: 0.7.6 already proved the agent-scope fix works - the event now reaches the handler. 0.7.8 adds a catch-all around the pre-step handler body. Evidence: the log now shows registered and enter lines (so the agent-scope fix truly worked) but never inject, and the UI reports a skills-without-inject failure with NO stack written anywhere - main.log, harness-*.log and renderer.log were all checked and contain none. Any exception thrown inside the handler was therefore completely invisible, leaving no option but guessing which line. The handler is now extracted into a named function and wrapped: on any uncaught error the stack is appended to skill-autoload.log as an ERROR line, then the error is re-thrown unchanged so dsh still fails the turn (never masked). 0.7.9 stops the duplicate injection: one session was injected four times in a row (08:58:02 / 05 / 10 / 33), 3301 bytes each. The idempotency check scans messages for an existing skill_content marker, but the pre-step payload arrives with messages=0 (no history), so every turn looked like the first one - poisoning the context linearly (10 turns = 33KB of the same text) and wasting tokens. A module-level WeakSet keyed on the agent object now short-circuits after the first injection and logs a skip line; WeakSet rather than Set so long-running hosts do not retain dead session objects. A host restart clears the marks, so a session re-injects once after a restart - acceptable, since the model genuinely needs the body again in a new process. Smoke grew three cases asserting inject-once behaviour (16 total). 0.7.5 adds a `registered` trace inside the ctx.effect callback. Evidence that forced it: skill-autoload.log has 50 `boot` lines and ZERO `enter` lines - since `boot` is written AFTER the `if (always.length === 0) return;` gate, the config was non-empty and execution must have reached the ctx.effect registration immediately below. So the handler was registered; the question became whether the effect callback itself ran, or whether the agent/pre-step event never reached it. Three lines now segment it exactly: boot (apply reached) - registered (effect callback ran) - enter (event arrived). Verified agent/pre-step is real and used by five built-in plugins (compaction-basic, agent-instructions, session-reference, time-context, tmux-context) and fired from core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts:242, so the event name is not the problem. 0.7.4 fixes the REAL reason autoload never fired (diagnosed 2026-10-20): cordis.presets.yml already declares `- id: vssaros-skills` WITHOUT config, so the insert in cordis.patch.yml (which carries config.skillAutoload) is skipped as a duplicate id - apply() receives an empty object, and installSkillAutoload returned early at `always.length === 0` BEFORE writing the boot line, which is why the log showed only two stale boot lines from 10-19 and nothing from the new Host. Now falls back to reading skillAutoload from this package's own cordis.patch.yml (tiny hand-written parse, no YAML dep); config still wins when it arrives. Added deps.autoloadFallback so the smoke tests can keep asserting 「empty config means no registration」. Same root cause as the kb plugin's `kb_list keys=[]`. 0.7.3 adds an ENTER trace to the autoload pre-step handler: the log showed only `boot` lines and zero `inject` lines, which cannot distinguish 「pre-step never fired」 from 「fired but idempotent-skipped / skill read failed」. Now every entry writes one `enter session=... messages=N` line - if enter appears but inject never does, the bug is inside this file (idempotency or skill lookup); if enter never appears, the event name / registration timing is wrong (needs dsh-side investigation). 0.7.2 fixes autoload OBSERVABILITY (the log never existed, which led me to wrongly conclude autoload never fired): logAutoload used dataRootOf(config), which delegates to foundation().dataRootOf() and THROWS when the foundation service is not bound yet - and binding happens asynchronously via ctx.inject, i.e. strictly after apply() - so every attempt threw and was swallowed by the catch. Logs now resolve via autoloadLogRoot: config.dataRoot -> dataRootOf() -> ~/.vssaros-dev fallback, none of which can throw. Also writes a boot line (skills=[...]) at registration, so 「plugin not loaded / config not passed」 and 「pre-step never fired」 are now distinguishable. Verified offline against the real skills dir: boot + inject both land in <root>/skill-autoload.log, and the injected message carries <skill_content name=...> (4289 bytes). Data contract: src/vs/sessions/contrib/agentStudio/common/skills.ts (ISkillDefinition)
